response.sql:
WITH per_source AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(1.0 * ss.boxy / ss.boxz) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS ss
    ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count
  FROM per_source
), kept AS (
  SELECT ps.avg_ratio, ps.record_count, o.avg_count
  FROM per_source AS ps
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE ps.record_count > o.avg_count
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_kept_sources_ratio,
  SUM(record_count) AS total_kept_spatial_records,
  AVG(record_count - avg_count) AS avg_excess_overall_source_average
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: The cross-source average includes funding-source groups with at least one matched spatial record; groups with no spatial records are not counted because the query starts from matched project and spatial rows.
